editions.headline: Core releases and bridge improvements
editions.intro: It has been a productive Sunday focused heavily on stabilizing our core tools and expanding how we connect different platforms. I spent a significant portion of my time reviewing community pull requests regarding autocomplete handling, testing tooling, and emoji logic. After sending several requests back for refinement, I was able to merge some important updates, most notably magic property support in `discordphp/discordphp#1497`. This work directly contributed to the release of two new versions, `v10.61.0` and `v10.62.0`, which include improved documentation for the `init` event and better exception handlers for scheduled events.

sections.title: Expanding the ecosystem
sections.body:
Beyond the core library, I focused on making our integrations more robust. I released `twitchphp/twitchphp#v3.4.0`, which brings much-needed improvements to connection handling and retry logic. To make this even more useful for creators, I added features to the Twitch bridges that can announce when streams go live or end, and I implemented a system to DM owners if a chat connection remains down. I also spent some time on the official website, adding a Discord server widget to the Community page and ensuring the site automatically rebuilds its maps on each release.

On the administrative side, I completed a series of updates to the Valgorithms server. This included refining the onboarding process, configuring new channels, and managing access and invitations to ensure everything is running smoothly for the community. I also took a moment to make the `discordphp/discordphp-newsletter` repository public and performed some minor maintenance on my other personal projects. It was a busy day of shipping code and tidying up our digital spaces, with just a quick 22-minute break to play some *Brawlhalla*.

editions.headline: Deep Dives and Website Updates
editions.intro:
Happy Sunday! I am so excited to be sending out my very first newsletter today. It feels great to finally have a dedicated space to share what I've been working on with all of you.

I've spent most of my morning diving deep into code reviews and making some progress on our web projects. It has been a busy morning of reviewing and managing code, particularly within `discord-php/DiscordPHP`. I spent a significant amount of time conducting extensive reviews, including requesting changes on `discord-php/DiscordPHP#1414` regarding the command handler register overhaul and `discord-php/DiscordPHP#1416` for the autocomplete callback matched option value.

sections.title: Web and Community Updates
sections.body:
I also managed several merges within `discord-php/DiscordPHP` to keep things moving forward, such as rebuilding maps on the official website and updating the documentation. Beyond the code reviews, I've been focusing on our web presence. On `discord-php/DiscordPHP.org`, I added a Discord server widget to the Community page and added descriptions for the release dispatch process. I also performed some maintenance on `valzargaming/valgorithms.com` by creating a newsletter branch.

To help keep our community organized, I also created a new channel within the Valgorithms Discord server. You can join us and head directly to the new #newsletter channel [here](https://discord.gg/4DYs7T9RE). The newsletter repository is also located [here](https://github.com/Valgorithms/DiscordPHP-Newsletter/), but it is still private.
